title: Promos
subtitle: Run a discount for all or chosen paid courses. While it runs, the home page shows a banner and a pop-up with the code.

fields.title: Promo title
fields.titleHelp: Shown on the banner and the pop-up, e.g. "Eid offer".
fields.bannerNote: Between the start and the end, every visitor sees the banner on top, a pop-up on the home and course pages, and the promo page with these courses. Buyers enter the code at payment (it is filled in for them).

courses.title: Courses in this promo
courses.label: Published courses
courses.empty: No published course matches these filters.

page.title: Promo courses
page.subtitle: {{discount}} with the code {{code}} on every course below.
page.none: No promo is running right now.

confirmOffMessage: Students can no longer use this promo code, and the banner and pop-up disappear.
confirmOnMessage: The promo code works again between its start and end dates.

design.info: Optional pictures for a running promo. The countdown and code are shown on top of them; without a picture the default design is used.

banner.title: Top banner picture
banner.hint: Wide picture, about 1600 × 200 px (PNG, JPEG, GIF or WEBP, up to 5 MB).

popup.title: Pop-up picture
popup.hint: Tall picture, about 600 × 800 px, shown in the centre pop-up on the home and course pages.

design.removeMessage: The default design is shown again.
